definitions.gloss: ATM; automated teller machine; cash machine
definitions.explanation: an electronic banking machine that allows customers to withdraw cash, check balances, and perform other banking transactions without a teller

examples.japanese: ATMでお{金|かね}を{下|お}ろす。
examples.english: I withdraw money from the ATM.

examples.japanese: コンビニのATMは{24時間|にじゅうよじかん}{使|つか}える。
examples.english: Convenience store ATMs can be used 24 hours a day.

examples.japanese: {年末年始|ねんまつねんし}はATMの{手数料|てすうりょう}が{高|たか}くなることがある。
examples.english: ATM fees can increase during the year-end and New Year holiday period.

notes:
DAILY VOCABULARY:
ATM (エーティーエム) machines are ubiquitous in Japan, found in banks, convenience stores (コンビニ), post offices ({郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}), and shopping centers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ATMでお{金|かね}を{下|お}ろす/{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す - withdraw money from ATM
- ATMに{入金|にゅうきん}する - deposit money at ATM
- ATMの{手数料|てすうりょう} - ATM fees
- ATMコーナー - ATM area

PRACTICAL NOTE:
Japanese ATMs often have limited hours at banks but are available 24 hours at convenience stores. International cards may not work at all ATMs—look for machines at post offices ({郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}) or 7-Eleven for better compatibility.
